title: Utterance
description: The base admission carrier: the ordered pair (Token, Claim), token slot first (owner-ruled). A Fregean unsaturated function: articulating opens it at the potential aperiodic articulation cell with the token slot filled and the claim slot empty (articulating/utterance.mts `articulate`) — the residue of unsaturation carried in that empty slot, never elided. Every public morphism of relating normalizes back through Mark → Utterance → articulate.
